title: AgentSteerParams
description: Params for agent.steer (ADR-anntnxdj decision 4): a person's message to the turn that is already running. The message is not a question — it carries no grants, no cwd and no attachments — because it reaches the agent that already holds the conversation's context, before its next model call.

runId.description: The backend-minted run id of the conversation's running turn.

text.description: The person's message, as they typed it. Bounded like a question: the same person types both and neither is a log.
